signals.rationale: The woman furrows her brows and looks away while processing the information. She then pauses and asks a clarifying question to confirm the spelling of the name.
She shakes her head slightly from side to side while listening and maintains a tense facial expression, indicating opposition to the topic.
Her lips press tightly together and her facial expression appears tense and annoyed as she listens to the other person.
She blinks rapidly and swallows noticeably while looking away, displaying physical signs of tension.
She shifts her gaze away and pauses before speaking, then asks a question to confirm the spelling, showing she is not fully sure of the information.

The speaker maintains an upright posture and delivers his message with a clear, steady voice. He speaks fluently without any filler words or hesitation, directly stating the correct spelling of the name.
